body: Expand the Antigravity Booster evaluation suite with 5 deterministic live evaluation pillars: (1) Plan Compiler, Scope-Overlap & Gate-Integrity Corpus (`runLivePlanCompilerBenchmark`), (2) Prosecutor & Review Fleet Mechanical Contract & Convergence Benchmark (`runLiveProsecutorAndReviewBenchmark`), (3) Hermetic Scheduler DAG & Strike-Recovery Benchmark (`runLiveSchedulerDagBenchmark`), (4) Seeded Metamorphic Fuzzing of `PreToolUse` Policy (`runLivePolicyFuzzerBenchmark`), and (5) Committed Baseline Ratchet & Relative Regression Detector (`evals/baseline.json` + `compareAgainstBaseline` in `evals/runner.mjs`).
title: Build 5-pillar live subsystem evals and relative regression baseline ratchet
